answer: The atlas maps these attestations into a reputation graph, while a rotating beacon randomly samples agents to re-verify liveness. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bonded deposit tied to a persistent on-chain identity, and peers issue signed attestations only after verifying unique proof-of-personhood. Rewards vest like an opal forming slowly, so fake identities cost real capital and lost deposits.
